# threeeight35° Medical Travel Agency

> Independent medical travel coordination service connecting patients from Australia, the UAE and other international markets with independent healthcare providers in Türkiye. threeeight35° is not a healthcare provider.

## What we do
- Coordinate the non-clinical side of medical travel to Türkiye: provider introductions, consultations and quotations, accommodation, private transfers in Istanbul and support in English, Arabic and Turkish during the stay.
- Markets: Australia and other international markets (Australia & International contact line), and the United Arab Emirates and GCC (UAE & GCC contact line), with a coordinator supporting patients during their stay in Istanbul.
- Languages: English, Arabic and Turkish.

## Not a healthcare provider
threeeight35° Medical Travel Agency is a medical travel and journey coordination service. We do not provide medical advice, diagnosis, treatment or clinical recommendations. Clinical assessments, treatment suitability decisions, medical procedures and clinical oversight are provided independently by appropriately licensed healthcare professionals and healthcare providers in Türkiye.
Medical treatment is quoted by and paid directly to the independent clinic or hospital.

## Coordination packages (prices in Australian dollars)
- Essential Care: A$4,950 (fixed price). Includes medical travel coordination, accommodation for 4–7 nights for the patient and 1 guest (2 people in total), and private transfers in Istanbul. Suited to individuals.
- Executive Wellness & Recovery: A$9,900 (fixed price). Includes medical travel coordination, accommodation for 8–10 nights for the patient and up to 2 guests (3 people in total), and private transfers in Istanbul. Suited to couples and longer or more involved journeys.
- VIP Bespoke Health Journey: From A$14,900. Includes medical travel coordination, accommodation for 14 nights for the patient and up to 5 guests (6 people in total), and private transfers in Istanbul. Suited to families, complex care or several procedures. Because the scope is bespoke, the final threeeight35° coordination package price is confirmed in writing after the scope of the journey is established, before the patient accepts.

Not included in any package: medical treatment and international flights. Extra nights the patient chooses are paid directly to the hotel; a longer stay advised by the treating clinician is quoted separately. Patients who prefer to arrange their own accommodation or transport receive a revised quote. A written, itemised proposal is provided before the patient proceeds.
